mapper.select: SELECT cls.* from bd_course cour LEFT JOIN bd_class cls ON cls.class_course_id = cour.id WHERE cour.id = #{courseId}

SELECT a.id, a.class_name, a.class_state, d.course_name, b.`name` help_teacher_name, c.`name` bishop_teacher_name, a.sum_students, a.exist_students, a.has_class, a.have_class, a.class_type, a.help_teacher_id, a.bishop_teacher_id, a.class_course_id FROM bd_class a LEFT JOIN bd_teacher b ON a.help_teacher_id = b.id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher c ON a.bishop_teacher_id = c.id LEFT JOIN bd_course d ON a.class_course_id = d.id WHERE a.mec_id = #{mecId} AND a.campus_id = #{campusId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.class_state = 0
AND a.class_type = #{classType}
and a.class_name like CONCAT('%',#{className},'%')
and a.class_state = #{classState}
and b.`name` like CONCAT('%',#{helpTeacherName},'%')
and c.`name` like CONCAT('%',#{bishopTeacherName},'%')
and d.course_name like CONCAT('%',#{courseName},'%')
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
, a.id DESC

SELECT cls.id, cls.class_name, cou.course_name FROM bd_class cls LEFT JOIN bd_course cou ON cls.class_course_id = cou.id WHERE cls.is_delete = 0 AND cls.mec_id = #{mecId} AND cls.campus_id = #{campusId} AND cls.class_state = 0
and cls.class_name like CONCAT('%',#{className},'%')
ORDER BY cls.create_time DESC
, cls.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.class_name, bt.`name` bishop_teacher_name, a.sum_students, a.exist_students, a.bishop_teacher_id, IF ( bc.not_arrived IS NULL, 0, bc.not_arrived ) not_arrived, IF ( bc.leave_num IS NULL, 0, bc.leave_num ) leave_num, IF ( bc.late_num IS NULL, 0, bc.late_num ) late_num, IF ( bc.actually_num IS NULL, 0, bc.actually_num ) actually_num FROM bd_class a LEFT JOIN bd_teacher bt ON a.bishop_teacher_id = bt.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT class_id, sum( IF ( type = 0, 1, 0 ) ) actually_num, sum( IF ( type = 1, 1, 0 ) ) late_num, sum( IF ( type = 2 OR type = 4, 1, 0 ) ) leave_num, sum( IF ( type = 3, 1, 0 ) ) not_arrived FROM bd_call_record where is_delete = 0 GROUP BY class_id ) bc ON a.id = bc.class_id WHERE a.mec_id = #{mecId} AND a.campus_id = #{campusId} AND a.is_delete = 0 AND a.class_state = 0
and a.class_name like CONCAT('%',#{className},'%')
and bt.`name` like CONCAT('%',#{bishopTeacherName},'%')
ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
, a.id DESC

SELECT cls.id, cls.id, cls.mec_id, cls.campus_id, cls.has_class, cls.have_class, cls.bishop_teacher_id, cls.help_teacher_id, cls.sum_students, cls.exist_students, cls.class_name, cls.class_course_id, cls.version, cls.is_delete, cls.class_type, cls.class_state, cls.create_time, cls.create_by, cls.update_time, cls.update_by, cou.course_name course_name, bis.`name` bishop_teacher_name, help_tea.name help_teacher_name FROM bd_class cls LEFT JOIN bd_course cou ON cou.id = cls.class_course_id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher bis ON cls.bishop_teacher_id = bis.id LEFT JOIN bd_teacher help_tea ON cls.help_teacher_id = help_tea.id WHERE cls.id = #{classId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bd_class SET has_class = has_class + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
